source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Review the WCB's requirements. (Refer to the preceding page.)
3. Review the records of all lost-time incidents, recordable medical aid only (i.e. doctor or hospital visits) incidents and non-occupational incidents.
4. Using the Records to Reportable Accidents form, make a note of any of the above mentioned incidents that are not currently up to date.

Reportable incidents must be updated by:

* Completing the Alberta WCB Accident Report Form
* Ensuring the incident has been fully documented on the Accident Report Form and the "Employer Information" section has been completed
* Forwarding the WCB Accident Report Form to the WCB office within three business days of receipt of the information that the injury or disease meets the definition of an occupational disease or injury or is a reportable incident as set out in the WCB Act, Alberta Regulation or the reportable incidents section of the Employer Guide.
